name: School Community Notification of Weapons Incident
description: Notice of a weapons possession incident to the parents and staff of the affected building, shared campus, or activity population.
recipient: Parents/guardians and employees of the affected building, campus, or activity
deadline: within twenty-four (24) hours of the incident
quote: Such notification(s) must occur within twenty-four (24) hours of the incident using a method of communication likely to reach designated parents/guardians and employees, unless the circumstances of the incident necessitate otherwise.
